connector.name: Basicops
connector.registryDescription: BasicOps MCP server for project management, tasks, notes, and team collaboration.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.basicops.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the basicops account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
